sentences.ar: توم حكى لبيكي عن بنت كان يحبها قبلها.
sentences.en: Tom told Becky about a girl he had liked before her.

sentences.ar: بيكي زعلت وما عادت تحكي معه.
sentences.en: Becky was upset and stopped speaking to him.
He tried to make up with her in every way.
He brought her a gift and she threw it on the ground.
Tom sat alone behind the school.

sentences.ar: قال: بدي أروح بعيد وما أرجع.
sentences.en: He said: I want to go far away and not come back.
